faq: Do I own the design files?
Yes. We build the prototype in a design tool under an account you own or share it with you as editor, so you can hand it to any developer later. We do not keep copies behind a paywall.
Can the prototype be turned into a real product?
That is the point. Developers can read the screens and styles directly. We can build it from the same file, or you can hand it to another team. Either way nothing needs redrawing.
Where do the test users come from?
You supply them, for example friends in your target market, customers or a small waitlist. We write the script, run the sessions and report back. We do not buy fake testers or recruit through spam.
What if I only have a rough idea of the screens?
Send what you have, even hand drawn sketches or screenshots of apps you like. We ask a few questions, agree the screen list with you first, and only then start designing.
